test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Magnificent
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. Splendid.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"magnificent"** means something that is extremely beautiful, elaborate, or impressive. (शानदार)

 
 
• **Example: **The palace was magnificent with its grand halls and exquisite decor.
 
 
 
• **"Splendid" **refers to something that is very impressive, excellent, or beautiful. (शानदार)
 
 
• **Example: **The garden was splendid with its colorful array of flowers and neatly trimmed hedges.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. Splendid.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Slow** (धीमा): Moving or operating, or designed to do so, only at a low speed; not quick or fast.

 
 
• **Example:** The slow turtle eventually crossed the finish line.
 
 
 
• **Sacred** (पवित्र): Connected with God or a god or dedicated to a religious purpose and so deserving veneration.
 
 
• **Example: **The temple is a sacred place for the local community.
 
 
 
• **Scared** (डरा हुआ): Fearful; frightened.
 
 
• **Example:** She was scared of the thunderstorm that raged outside.
